link.title: Service link
link.intro: The link is permanent and reusable. The case is only created when the client submits the form.
link.paramsNote: Language, currency and country are set here, so the client opens the link with everything right — the phone dialling code comes from the country ({dial}). They can change it, but by default they see what makes sense in their market.
link.noAmountNote: There is no amount to charge here: the payment link is generated automatically after the client chooses an offer and fills in the details of every passenger. Until then there is no amount and no passenger to charge.
link.bareNote: No parameters. The client picks language and currency, and the case comes in with no seller assigned.
